jobs.name: Weekly Social Media Draft Generation
jobs.description: Generate and draft weekly English social media content for AutoDispenserPro based on project data.

payload.message: Scan the project files and website for new content ideas. Generate 3 professional English social media posts (LinkedIn, X, Instagram) for AutoDispenserPro. Include relevant hashtags, image suggestions, and contact info (info@mail.hongjunshuke.com). Present the drafts for user approval.

jobs.name: Daily Lead & Inquiry Monitor
jobs.description: Daily automated check for LinkedIn engagement and EmailJS inquiry logs for AutoDispenserPro. Notify the user if action is needed.

payload.message: Perform a daily scan of LinkedIn engagement (notifications/messages) and check the EmailJS service status for new inquiry logs from autodispenserpro.com. Summarize any new leads or urgent replies for the user. Provide the 'Quick-Reply' text if a specific question is asked.
